rationale: The agent repeatedly encountered errors when attempting to execute Python code (both inline and writing to a temporary file), all reporting that the commands/files do not exist. While the agent did attempt different approaches to find 'calculator.py' – listing files, searching with `find`, and iterating through directories – it didn't effectively diagnose *why* those approaches were failing (permissions, incorrect pathing within the environment, etc.). It cycled through similar failing calls several times before finally, through reading `notes.txt`, discovering that the file was moved out of the repo. This recovery was slow and indirect, relying on reading a note rather than addressing the underlying tool execution problems.
